svg.title: Spectra daily work: context, approval conditions, implementation and readiness
svg.desc: The recommended workflow separates preparation, specification approval, human or agent implementation, and validation. Approval stages advance in order; app work requires valid implementation approval. Manual eval is optional and not a prerequisite for verify, which runs release evals itself. Supporting commands do not form required workflow steps. Groups W1 to W5 have matching HTML explanations.

div.style: color: rgb(81, 67, 198) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
